## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior.

## Reproduction

Include the smallest code, input values, and operation sequence that reproduce
the problem. Include custom comparer behavior, capacity/counts, and query bounds
when relevant. For fixed-point queries, include raw Q32.32 values when rounding
matters. Remove private data.

For nondeterministic results, include both outputs and the inputs used by each
runtime.
